items.question: Who is Tayler Hill?
items.answer: Tayler Hill is a guard who played in the WNBA from 2013 to 2019 for the Washington Mystics and Dallas Wings. Washington drafted her fourth overall in 2013 out of Ohio State. Her most recent season was 2019, when she played four games before season-ending knee surgery.

items.question: Where did Tayler Hill play college basketball?
items.answer: Tayler Hill played four seasons at Ohio State, starting all four years. She made the All-Big Ten First Team twice and finished as the fifth-leading scorer in school history.

items.question: Did Tayler Hill play for the Dallas Wings?
items.answer: Yes. Washington traded Tayler Hill to the Dallas Wings on July 23, 2018, for Aerial Powers. She played for Dallas in 2018 and 2019.

items.question: Does Tayler Hill have a son?
items.answer: Yes. Tayler Hill's son was born June 18, 2014, according to her WNBA bio.
